role.description: Prepares reports, dashboards and ad hoc analyses for the sales and operations teams of a healthcare provider.
responsibilities: data analysis and ad hoc reports for business teams
data quality checks and fixes with data owners
data requirements, definitions and metric logic
data for audit and regulatory requests
documentation of data sources and reports

stakeholders.role_or_group: line manager (Head of Data or Analytics)

high_impact_areas: data errors in management or regulatory reports
broken data pipelines or failed refreshes
access to personal or sensitive data
extra_urgency_signals: report needed for a meeting or committee date
failed dashboard refresh or numbers that look wrong
data request from management or an auditor
low_priority: automated report distributions and refresh confirmations
tool release notes and vendor webinars
